shots.action: Shot 1 — urgent comic arrival. Dark clouds gather over the cove while the Crystal Bears actively watch the storm: rain drives across them, fur and clothing move in gusts, and each bear breathes, blinks, shifts weight and tracks the sea. Fuzzby enters from several bear-lengths away, genuinely tiny beside the bears. He fails to brake, makes one readable hard shell deflection, skids and tumbles across wet sand, then crash-lands short of the group rather than beside or inside it. Still winded, with his chest visibly heaving, he checks himself and forces out I meant to do that as a half-beat cover-up; the breathlessness never stops and the proud mask immediately collapses when his eyes find the sea. Shot 2 — the warning, without resetting the beach geography. The bears lean toward him and exchange concerned looks rather than freezing. Fuzzby struggles upright, then scrambles and flies closer while shouting BEARS! BEARS! to the still-distant group. He stops short of them and continues the same exhausted breath into There’s someone out there and they’re — they’re — they’re — without ever becoming bear-sized or entering their cluster. Zenny arrives behind him, steady as ever, and supplies the missing meaning. Fuzzby points at her gratefully; every bear follows the exchange and then turns with focused concern toward the offshore danger.

shots.action: Shot 1 — locate the danger. Aida steps forward to the water’s edge. The wind stirs her fur gently, but she remains still. She looks out across the stormy sea. Through the rain we glimpse a tiny boat rising and falling between waves. The bears all look out. Concern. Hope. Aida turns to them. Shot 2 — answer together, continuing from Aida's turn. The bears gather closer. CRYSTAL CALL SEQUENCE. Aida touches her pendant. Her ROSE QUARTZ glows warmly. The other Crystal Bears touch their crystals one by one. A pulse of color from each. Misty’s crystal glows. Luna’s. Howey’s. Together the bears speak as one.

[Intended Read]
A storm-cove wide frame holds the Crystal Bears together on the shore before the interruption: the world feels pressured by weather, the group feels unified and watchful, and the open beach reads as a clear comedy runway for Fuzzby's imminent failed arrival.

[Canonical Style]
Feature-quality stylized 3D CGI. Plush character materials with subsurface scattering; soft fur with individual strands catching the light; glossy eyes with bright catchlights; translucent wing membranes where light passes through. Warm amber key light with cool blue fill and a soft rim light; teal-orange cinematic grade. Shallow depth of field with soft bokeh, gentle ambient occlusion, subtle film grain. Appealing exaggerated proportions, large expressive eyes, soft rounded features. Emotionally warm atmosphere.

[Geography]
Camera faces out from the cove beach toward the stormy sea, with the shoreline running diagonally from lower-right foreground to center-left midground.
The Crystal Bears start grouped on the lower-left/center-left shore, all on the same wet-sand depth plane near the waterline.
Aida stands slightly forward within the group, with the other bears loosely gathered behind and beside her rather than in a straight lineup.
Screen-right foreground and midground beach remain open as Fuzzby's later travel corridor toward the group.
The sea and horizon occupy the center background; crystal cliffs and glowing rock formations frame the far left and far right edges.
Shells and driftwood sit on the open beach as readable future obstacle geography without blocking the corridor.

[Frame]
- Aida @ lower-left area; playable watchful standing anticipation, slightly forward within the group; facing three-quarter toward the sea and open beach.
- Amie @ lower-left area; playable attentive standing anticipation within the cluster; facing three-quarter toward the sea and group center.
- Howey @ lower-left area; playable steady standing anticipation, readable beside Aida; facing three-quarter toward the sea and open beach.
- Luna @ lower-centre area; playable calm standing anticipation at the right edge of the group; facing three-quarter toward the sea with awareness of the open beach.
- Misty @ lower-centre area; playable alert standing anticipation, clear silhouette behind the front anchor; facing three-quarter toward the sea and Aida.
- Sunny @ lower-right area; playable curious standing anticipation, leaving lead room to frame-right; facing three-quarter toward the sea and open beach.
- Same depth: Aida 60 inches; Amie 46 inches; Howey 70 inches; Luna 54 inches; Misty 65 inches; Sunny 50 inches; preserve relative-size truth only.

[Negative Space]
Hold empty space across the screen-right foreground and midground beach for Fuzzby's later high-speed entrance and ricochet path.
Keep a clear pocket behind the later Fuzzby landing area for Zenny entering later; do not place any opening character there.
Reserve the lower-center wet-sand strip as an unobstructed performance corridor between the shells, driftwood and the gathered bears.

[Camera]
Low child-height coastal wide, camera about bear chest height for Aida, slightly looking across the beach toward the sea rather than straight-on portrait staging. Use a moderately wide animated-feature lens relationship, approximately 28–32mm equivalent, with gentle perspective and no extreme distortion. The camera is grounded on the wet sand, angled so the shore runs laterally from screen-right toward the group at screen-left, preparing one readable lateral travel idea without showing the later entrance.

[Light]
Use the approved storm-cove palette and materials from @图7: cool blue-grey storm ambience, pearly wet-sand reflections, glowing crystal accents in the rocks, soft rim light from the bright horizon, and scattered rain streaks. Keep all six bears on the same practical shore plane with consistent scale; separate them from the background using soft horizon backlight, wet-sand bounce and subtle crystal glints, not theatrical spotlighting. Depth should show foreground shells and grasses, midground bears and waterline, and distant storm sea, while preserving clear character readability.

[Performance Freedom]
Animation owns performance, movement, recovery and camera evolution.

[Protect]
Exactly one Aida, one Amie, one Howey, one Luna, one Misty and one Sunny appear in this image.
Keep Aida, Amie, Howey, Luna, Misty, Sunny at the same distance from the camera; preserve their canonical relative heights.
Include only the openingCharactersInFrame cast: Aida, Amie, Howey, Luna, Misty and Sunny; do not include Fuzzby or Zenny in this opening keyframe.
Preserve wearable state locks: Aida jewelled brow headdress; Amie purple teardrop pendant; Howey silver tiara, pendant and armbands; Misty blue teardrop pendant; Sunny multicoloured flower-bead collar.
Do not depict Fuzzby's crash, Zenny's entrance, pointing, dialogue, panic, or any later action beat; this is frame-one anticipation only.
Natural staging lock: restage Aida, Amie, Howey, Luna, Misty, Sunny from identity reference into the authored scene action. Each body has believable balance, weight through the feet or supported hover, relaxed shoulders and naturally bent elbows; arms rest by the body or perform a motivated story action. Never copy a turnaround's front, side or presentation pose; no arms held out from the body, T-pose, model-sheet stance, evenly spread limbs or symmetrical display posture.
Living performance lock: Aida, Amie, Fuzzby, Howey, Luna, Misty, Sunny, Zenny has a specific motivated eyeline target and a readable active thought in the eyes. Use a precise asymmetric expression; no vacant forward stare, unfocused eyes, frozen smile, mannequin pose or generic camera-facing expression.

[Forbidden]
No portrait, locked extreme action pose or payoff, identity or scale drift, changed accessories, omitted reference features, duplicates, anatomy errors, extra props, text, watermark or body-mounted bags, sacks, baskets or dangling loads. Preserve the locked Scene Look.
